verdict.rationale: The H200 is physical hardware sold as SXM modules/HGX systems for deployment in customer-owned data centers, embedded systems, and on-prem workstations, which is the hardware equivalent of self-hosting; evidence confirms NVIDIA-Certified Systems and partner servers with 4-8 GPUs for enterprise data centers. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation of the full self-hosting process (procurement, rack/power/cooling specs, driver/software stack setup) and no independent hands-on report of a customer standing up self-hosted H200 infrastructure.
